training.role: operator and acceptance-threshold qualification only; no thermophysical parameter fitting

holdout.role: untouched one-pass validation after the complete contract and production parameters are frozen

window_decision: Each window starts at the preceding ten-minute boundary at least 30 minutes before P1 and ends at the following ten-minute boundary at least 30 minutes after P4. The buffer supplies a non-eclipse baseline and was selected from published contact times, not AMPS residuals.

binning.aggregation_order: quality-select native footprints; assign each channel footprint by its own clat/clon and UTC; average calibrated radiance within the predeclared site/time bin; convert the mean radiance to brightness temperature; then calculate T_bol

quality.qge_interpretation: bits 2 and 3 (definitive but not reprocessed pointing/ephemeris) are retained; predictive or missing geometry bits 4-7 and reserved bits 0-1 are rejected
quality.qmi_interpretation: the eclipse bit is physical event metadata and is retained; transient, abnormal thermal state, drift, noise, saturation, moving, and reserved bits are rejected
quality.native_temperature_handling: Do not reject negative C3-C8 brightness temperatures before binning; calibrated low-signal channels may be negative and the published Paige sensitivity substitution handles them after radiance aggregation. C9 must yield a finite positive binned brightness temperature.

bolometric_operator.reference: Paige et al. 2010 Science 330, 479 supplementary methods
bolometric_operator.low_sensitivity_rule: Replace a below-threshold channel brightness temperature with the next longer-wavelength channel whose brightness temperature exceeds its own threshold.

uncertainty.calibration_reference: Diviner Radiometric Test Report, equations 1-3 and Tables 4 and 10
uncertainty.ground_calibration_rule: Use the report's in-flight fractional uncertainty as the stated upper limit for ground calibration and combine the two in quadrature, hence sqrt(2) times Table 10.
uncertainty.within_bin_rule: standard error of the accepted calibrated radiances; real dispersion is preserved and no fixed kelvin error is assigned
uncertainty.combination: calibration radiance uncertainty and within-bin radiance standard error combined in quadrature, then propagated through the native radiance-to-brightness conversion and Paige T_bol operator
uncertainty.tbol_propagation: independent-channel first-order Jacobian propagation about each binned mean; finite-difference evaluations remain on the same published sensitivity/positivity branch; a channel below its C3-C8 sensitivity floor has zero local derivative because Paige substitution removes it; an exact-threshold value uses the valid-branch right derivative
uncertainty.covariance_limitation: the archive does not provide cross-channel covariance; no covariance is assumed or fabricated

model_operator.thermal_parameters: fixed Hayne et al. values already declared in the application input; June observations are not used to fit them
model_operator.channel_6_9_diagnostics: grey-emissivity rectangular-half-maximum calibration approximation; diagnostic only and excluded from the primary pass/fail score
